item.text: I’m submitting one local SDK program that performs the seven preview workflows in the required order, prints only the final packet, and then I’ll issue the finish request.

The first submission was rejected before execution because the SDK import path was outside the allowed guide surface. I’m correcting only that import and resubmitting the same single-program workflow.
The harness has now marked the SDK execution slot as already consumed, so it will not accept another program submission. I’m issuing the required finish call with the mandated summary.
